title: Notice of Addition & Removal of Trading Pairs - 2023-09-22
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians , Binance will be adding and delisting selected spot trading pairs, as per the timeline below. Timeline: At  2023-09-22 08:00 (UTC) , Binance will open trading for the ARK/USDT, CREAM/USDT, FTT/USDT, GFT/USDT, IQ/USDT and USDT/VAI spot trading pairs. At  2023-09-29 03:00 (UTC) , Binance will remove and cease trading on the ARK/BUSD, CREAM/BUSD, FTT/BUSD, GFT/BUSD, IQ/BUSD and BUSD/VAI spot trading pairs.  Please note: The delisting of a spot trading pair does not affect the availability of the tokens on Binance Spot. Users can still trade the spot trading pair’s base and quote assets on other trading pair(s) that are available on Binance.  At  2023-09-29 03:00 (UTC) ,   Binance will terminate Spot Trading Bots services for the spot trading pairs that are to be delisted, where applicable. Users are strongly advised to update and/or cancel their Spot Trading Bots prior to the cessation of Spot Trading Bots services to avoid any potential losses. Users are encouraged to  convert their BUSD assets  into other available assets on Binance  prior to February 2024 .  Users may  trade their BUSD balances for FDUSD  at zero trading fees, or  convert their BUSD balances to FDUSD  at 1:1 using the convert portal.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For More Information: Binance Delisting Guidelines & Frequently Asked Questions How to View Delisting Information for Spot and Margin Tokens/Trading Pairs on Binance Binance Encourages Users to Convert BUSD to Other Stablecoins Prior to February 2024 Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-09-21
